solution.summary: In this paper, we propose CenterFormer, a center-based transformer network for 3D object detection. To further aggregate features from multiple frames, we design an approach to fuse features through cross-attention.
solution.approach: In this paper, we propose CenterFormer, a center-based transformer network for 3D object detection.

evidence.quote: In this paper, we propose CenterFormer, a center-based transformer network for 3D object detection.
To further aggregate features from multiple frames, we design an approach to fuse features through cross-attention.
Can we design a transformer encoder-decoder network for the LiDAR point cloud in order to better perceive the global connection of point cloud data?

experiments.summary: The results show significant improvements over the strong baseline of anchor-free object detection networks. CenterFormer achieves state-of-the-art performance for a single model on the Waymo Open Dataset, with 73.7% mAPH on the validation set and 75.6% mAPH on the test set,

evidence.quote: The results show significant improvements over the strong baseline of anchor-free object detection networks.

CenterFormer achieves state-of-the-art performance for a single model on the Waymo Open Dataset, with 73.7% mAPH on the validation set and 75.6% mAPH on the test set, significantly outperforming all previously published CNN and transformer-based methods.
